**4.2 notes are drafted** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

Out of 380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 added, 9 fixed. The rest is deps, tests, CI.

The three breaking ones need your eye. The `v1` export route was dropped in `56dc828`. Error types stopped being re-exported across `db`, `core`, `jobs`, and `auth`. Expired tokens now return 401, not 403.

Four perf commits sit in an HTML comment. Your shape has no Performance heading.

One open thing. Six commits say `docs: note the minimum node version` and CI moved to node 22. No `engines` change showed up. Check if the floor really moved.
